messages:
maria: Heads-up: Sales wants to enable BYOK for an EU banking customer this afternoon. They need RBAC changes + assurance on audit logs and HSM custody boundaries. @kevin will own RBAC. @dave can you look at the HSM proxy risk?

kevin: On it. Which roles need access? Is this the 'customer-managed key' model where we never handle plaintext? Need exact contract wording before I draft permissions.

dave: FYI I noticed a crash on the hsm-proxy canary last night — segfault in vendor FFI when loading the token library. I'm triaging now. Might block onboarding until we confirm stability.

lina: If hsm-proxy is flaky we can't provide the SLA. @ops-bot please open an incident. Also, what retention period does the customer require for audit logs?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-442. Pager set to oncall-eng-security. Linked channels: #incidents #eng-security. :robot_face:

kevin: RBAC proposal idea: create group `byok-custops-eu` with read-only access to crypto metadata + an `invoke-key` action gated by a 2-operator approval workflow. Map that group to our RBAC plugin (okta->internal role mapping). Need the exact attribute schema.

dave: The crash looks like an FFI race on token init. Temp mitigations I can enact now: run hsm-proxy in isolated process namespace, enable supervisor auto-restart, and route healthcheck failures to fallback kms-proxy. Also enable verbose audit for any import/op:
```
# enable verbose audit for import ops
curl -X POST https://audit.internal/api/v1/config -d '{"audit_level":"verbose","filters":["hsm.import","hsm.unwrap","hsm.rewrap"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

maria: Legal insists on demonstrating we never see unwrapped key material. Suggest we require the customer to publish a sha256 of the key material at import time (customer-side), and we store only that hash and the operator IDs in the immutable audit entry. No raw key material ever stored.

lina: Agree. For compliance we should add an immutable log entry to a tamper-evident store (sigstore or a signed entry in vault-transit) containing: operator IDs, operation type, external key-hash, and short justification text. Also include KMS attestation blob if vendor supports it.

kevin: I'll draft the RBAC PR and the minimal onboarding checklist. Quick question: do we have an existing KMS integration guide for BYOK+HSM attestation? If not, I need to write a one-pager for the SRE/support team.

maria: We don't have a public guide yet. Proposed immediate checklist for today: 1) apply temporary mitigations for hsm-proxy (dave), 2) PR for RBAC + approval workflow (kevin), 3) define audit retention & immutable log flow (lina), 4) create customer attestation checklist & sample commands (kevin), 5) legal signoff (lina). If anyone can't meet the ETA call out now.

kevin: I'll own items 2 and 4 and legal signoff coordination. ETA ~3h.

dave: I'll finish vuln triage and push the opt-out route (fallback to kms-proxy) now. ETA ~1h. Will post root cause and a patch link.

lina: I'll loop in legal and support, and ask support to pause new BYOK imports until we mark this green.

ops-bot: Update: INC-2026-442 status = investigating; involved teams = eng-security, eng-runtime, support. Notifications posted to oncall and #incidents.

maria: Thanks team. Keep updates brief. If onboarding will be delayed >4h escalate to PM and Sales so expectations are set.
